title: Moonlit Lavender Wanderer
description: A lone hiker with a backpack and walking stick stands on a rocky cliff edge overlooking a vast field of glowing purple lavender. In the night sky, a large luminous moon contains four ethereal female faces with flowing hair, while below it a green dragon flies near a gothic castle on a distant hill.
prompt: A lone hiker with backpack and walking stick stands on a rocky cliff overlooking endless rows of glowing purple lavender fields at night. In the dark sky a giant luminous moon contains four overlapping ethereal female faces with long flowing hair and subtle symbols, a green dragon flies near a gothic castle on a distant hill, mystical and surreal fantasy scene.
